Industrial Designer
San Francisco, CA - Hybrid
At IDEO, we use design to create new products, services, experiences; tangible strategies; and creative capabilities.
IDEO San Francisco is in search of a new Industrial Designer to partner with interdisciplinary teams designing innovative and human-centered physical products and services. This role will own a hands-on workstream emphasizing creative problem solving, core industrial design skills, rapid prototyping and advanced visual storytelling.

The ideal hire will champion hands-on making & prototyping, and collaborate fluidly with a wide variety of design professionals from communications design to UX researchers (and everything in between).This hire will have the unique opportunity to design cutting edge products, and grow as a Design Thinking practitioner within IDEO’s diverse network of Design Directors, Partners and Business Leaders.
At IDEO, an Industrial Designer is responsible for independently executing components of highly complex client projects, showcasing advanced skills in user-centered physical product design . You will integrate form and function, while balancing user needs and technical considerations to create solutions that resonate with users and businesses alike.

What makes a career at IDEO unique is our radical empathy and compassion for the user, always leading with creative confidence and collaborative rigor.

You will work with world-class researchers, business designers, data scientists, and others disciplines outside of design, to push the edges of your craft, creating solutions that are as inclusive as they are transformative.
We are especially excited to meet candidates with exceptional visual storytelling abilities, a drive to “get out from behind the screen” by prototyping in both digital and physical realms, and a grounding in design for manufacturing (DFM). This hire must be within a commutable distance of IDEO’s San Francisco studio. IDEO proudly supports flexible work.

Apply your expertise to develop compelling physical product designs and systems, balancing form, function, technical constraints and manufacturability.
Collaborate with interdisciplinary teams, including mechanical/electrical engineers, software developers, visual and interaction designers, brand strategists, and design researchers.
Present ideas through sketches, CAD models, renderings, and physical mock-ups to clients and team members.
Actively contribute to and lead human-centered research to inform design strategies.
Create prototypes at varying fidelities using tools such as 3D printing and other rapid prototyping methods to explore, test, validate design concepts, and aid research efforts.
Drive cross-functional collaboration and demonstrate leadership over the course of 12+ week projects
Deliver exceptional visual storytelling using an array of 2D and 3D tools and techniques, creating compelling presentations for clients.
Explore early-stage inspiration through digital experimentation, including generative AI and other innovative tools.
Mentor fellow designers within and across disciplines by sharing knowledge, articulating industrial design processes, and demonstrating advanced craft techniques.

1-2+ years of experience + internships in industrial design, including end-to-end contributions to projects in consumer products, medical devices, soft goods or packaging.
Demonstrated fluency in digital tools such as SolidWorks, Rhino, Keyshot, Blender, and Adobe Creative Suite.
Go-to-market (GTM) experience, with the ability to meaningfully contribute to the associated industrial design workstreams within multidisciplinary teams.
Prototyping expertise, including 3D printing and other rapid prototyping methods.
A passion for building in 3D while actively prototyping in real time to test insights.
Visual storytelling abilities, including strong instincts in graphic design and deck-building.
Strong theoretical or practical understanding of and ability to collaborate on the design for manufacturing (DFM) process.

IDEO is committed to paying its employees equitably, regardless of gender identity or race/ethnicity/cultural identity. We support the holistic well-being of our community by providing a thoughtfully designed benefits package.
The salary range for this role is $70,000 - $80,000 USD. This range is influenced by several factors, including skills, experience, and geographic location. Final offers may vary based on these considerations.
In addition to base compensation + Health Benefits, IDEO offers a rich benefits package including the following when officially a FTE:

Family & Caregiving: Parental Leave, Adoption Assistance, Fertility Assistance, Transgender Medical Assistance, Breastmilk shipment, Back-up/Dependent Care, Pet Insurance
Other Benefits: Flexible Work, Flexible Time Off, Paid Holidays, Annual Education Stipend, Home Office Stipend
Commitment to Diversity
At IDEO, we are committed to the work of advancing diversity, equity and inclusion within our organization and in the world. Our purpose of having disproportionate, world-changing impact through design is directly connected to our ability to bring many different perspectives to the table. This applies to our candidates, the people we hire, the clients and customers we serve, and the communities we learn from in our research.
As a human-centered organization, we are committed to working with and designing for people of every race, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, socio-economic status, physical ability or attribute, religion, national origin, or political belief. We recognize that this commitment requires ongoing work and sustained attention, as well as adaptation to new insights and best practices.

Peloton is an award-winning health and fitness brand that builds connected products and experiences that matter. We are currently looking for a hard-working Industrial Designer with 8+ years of experience to join our team with relevant experience in an adjacent industry such as automotive, aerospace, or large equipment.

In this role, you will lead and support the aesthetic, functional, and usability development of large-scale fitness equipment throughout the full design development process.

Our ideal candidate has a passion for health and fitness and is excited to work closely with our passionate team of designers, engineers, outside vendors, and key business partners to bring ideas to life.

Design & develop large-scale fitness equipment and manage the development of the integrated subsystems and member input devices
Work closely with Product Management, Mechanical Engineering, UX Testing, and Software to develop engaging fitness equipment for our members
End-to-end product development from research and early concept exploration, to product DFM and launch
Make design decisions for a product and/or component and show/explain how those decisions were made
Use a variety of inputs to stimulate creative thinking, make design proposals, and evolve our design language
Communicate your ideas via physical prototypes, sketches, 2D presentations, and CAD - effectively articulating your design ideas to partners across the company
Implement all tasks with high quality - develop, deploy and maintain design intent with limited oversight
Produce work that is free of major technical defects - you are able to debug and fix issues when they arise, mostly independently
Troubleshoot technical challenges with cross-functional partners and vendors to maintain design intent
Actively engage the team in discussions and foster healthy design debates and mediate conversations between functions to help drive toward decisions
Own and drive presenting your work - carefully crafting your presentations based on understanding your target audience
Facilitate brainstorms within your design team to stimulate creative thinking and capture ideas
Simultaneously work across 2+ projects at various stages of development - leading and supporting workstreams as needed
Specify CMF for all user-facing parts and ensure production parts meet design and CMF requirements

You have a proven understanding of the Product Development Process and are able to manage complex design assemblies. Your work is detailed, and well thought out
You lead sophisticated projects with direction from program leaders and input from cross-functional partners
You have the ability to self-define relevant parameters to work within; set and prioritize deliverables with appropriate timeframes to meet program & phase gate objectives
You ask the right questions to help inform and define outcomes/results for yourself and other designers
You have experience bringing analog and digital products to market that meet rigorous ergonomic and usability requirements
You have experience developing small and large-scale mass-produced products that use a variety of manufacturing methods including but not limited to plastic injecting modeling, metal stamping, welding, die casting, extrusions, and soft goods
You have a passion for design in all its forms and compelling skills, including the ability to translate brand values into captivating narratives, products, and experiences
Bachelor's Degree in Industrial Design
10+ years of relevant work experience
Highly proficient in analog and digital sketching with compelling sketch/rendering skills
Proficient in Solidworks (working with surface modeling + curvature continuous CAD)
Proficient in Keyshot
Proficient in Adobe Photoshop & Illustrator
Experience using Google Docs, Slides, Sheets (or equivalent)

Fitness industry experience
Advanced surfacing with Solidworks or other parametric modeling software
Personal interest in wellness or fitness
*Please note: Portfolio Submission is required to be considered for this role. PDF is preferred over web if possible. Your portfolio must show process, problem-solving, and prototyping.

Junior Industrial Designer
Simulands is a company specialized in developing Human Grade simulators for training, research, and education in the cardiovascular field. Our solutions enable physicians and professionals to practice with real devices supported by real imaging, replicating complex clinical conditions in a safe and controlled environment.
Our mission is to transform the way cardiology is taught and learned, making clinical practice safer for patients and more effective for physicians. By combining engineering, research, and passion, we create learning experiences that go beyond theory, preparing the cardiologists of the future with concrete, realistic, and innovative tools.
We are looking for a Junior Industrial Designer to join our design team. The ideal candidate has a strong passion for design, technical curiosity, and a desire to grow in a collaborative and dynamic environment.
Function: Junior Industrial Designer
Job Type: Full Time position
Reporting to: Design Manager
Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Industrial Design or related fields
Languages: Fluent English oral \& written. German represents a plus.
Personal traits: We are looking for someone with a structured and disciplined approach to work, coupled with strong attention to detail. The ideal candidate is eager to learn, proactive in tackling challenges independently, and capable of managing their responsibilities with minimal supervision. Success in this role requires adaptability to shifting priorities, the ability to stay organized, and a collaborative spirit to contribute effectively within a small, fast\-paced Design team.

Highly skilled in 3D CAD applications (SolidWorks)
Experienced in continuous CAD surfacing theory.
Knowledge of other modelling software (Rhino, Blender, etc...)
Knowledge in 2D design software (Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, In Design, etc)
Experienced in rendering software (Keyshot)
Ability to create prototypes with rapid prototyping tools
Familiarity with 3D printing technologies: FDM, SLA, MultiJet/PolyJet, and SLS
Understanding of traditional manufacturing processes (molding, machining, composite materials, etc.)
Strong attention to detail, aesthetic sensibility, and technical accuracy.
Team player attitude, proactivity, and willingness to learn
Basic skills in UX/UI and design thinking processes (nice to have)
Familiarity with Figma for prototyping and digital interface support (nice to have)

Involvement in full design process from initial design concept through to final product launch.
Support the team in product and component design, from concept to prototype
Create sketches, 3D models, and high\-quality renderings
Collaborate with engineering and production departments to turn concepts into feasible solutions
Contribute to research on materials, design trends, and innovation
Prepare presentations and technical documentation for projects and clients
Take ownership of projects and capability of working without close supervision
Interested?
Please attach your CV and portfolio (PDF), highlighting your design projects and 3D modeling experience. We look forward to discovering your creativity and skills!

Who We Are
We are a rapidly growing embodied AI company revolutionizing human labor. Leveraging cutting-edge robotics and advanced artificial intelligence, we develop transformative technologies that redefine how work is done across multiple industries — empowering businesses to streamline operations, boost productivity, and unlock new possibilities.

We're looking for a talented Industrial Designer to shape the look, feel, and usability of our next-generation autonomous robot systems. In this role, you'll translate technical requirements into compelling product designs, working closely with our Mechanical Engineering team to ensure your designs are both visually strong and grounded in engineering reality.

Design housings, enclosures, and user-facing components for autonomous robot systems, balancing aesthetics, ergonomics, and brand identity.
Develop concept sketches, renderings, and 3D models to communicate design intent to stakeholders.
Translate design concepts into manufacturable geometry in close collaboration with Mechanical Engineers.

Work hand-in-hand with mechanical, electrical, and software teams to ensure designs integrate seamlessly with internal components.
Build and evaluate prototypes (foam, 3D-printed, or CNC) to validate form, fit, and user experience.
Iterate designs based on manufacturability, cost, and technical feedback.

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Industrial Design, Product Design, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
Strong portfolio demonstrating both aesthetic sensibility and technical understanding of materials and manufacturing.
Proficiency in CAD software (SolidWorks, Rhino, Fusion 360, or similar) and rendering tools (KeyShot, Blender).
Solid understanding of manufacturing processes (injection molding, sheet metal, CNC, 3D printing).
Ability to work at the intersection of design and engineering, and to communicate design decisions to a technical audience.
